comments.author: slesaad
comments.body:
setting `L_.layers.layer[s.name] = false` for DeckGL causes a full data refetch and layer rebuild on every toggle off -> on. this is inefficient. DeckGL does support a `visible` prop that would allow instant toggling without rebuild:

i'd
  - add a comment explaining why this is needed
  - create a follow-up issue to optimize using `visible` prop

not a blocker for this PR, but worth tracking.

comments.author: dzole0311
comments.body: @slesaad there was a weird issue with the toggle in MMGIS but I've updated this part now by calling engine.updateLayer(nativeLayer, { visible: false }) to toggle the visible prop in-place
